headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals made a statement with a 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, led by Alec Burleson's three home runs and six RBIs. The Washington Nationals fell short in Philadelphia, losing 3-6 to the Phillies, with Derek Hill contributing a home run and 4 RBIs.

Injuries continue to impact teams, with the Oakland Athletics placing lefty Jeffrey Springs on the 15-day injured list due to right hip discomfort. The Athletics also added right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson to their roster via trade with the Philadelphia Phillies. The Chicago Cubs placed RHP Clay Holmes on the 60-day injured list, while the Los Angeles Dodgers placed C Dalton Rushing on the 10-day injured list.

The Athletics made a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies, acquiring RHP Seth Johnson in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 3-6 loss to the Philadelphia Phillies, with Derek Hill leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Andrew Alvarez pitched 6.1 innings for the Nationals, allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Blast Past Yankees 13-7**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 4-3 Win Over Brewers**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close matchup, securing a 4-3 victory. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 3 RBIs on a single hit in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall to Cubs in 5-10 Thrashing**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Los Angeles Dodgers, securing a 5-10 victory. Michael Busch led the Dodgers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Lefty on Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have placed left-handed pitcher Jeffrey Springs on the 15-day injured list, retroactive to August 1, 2026, due to right hip discomfort.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson, who was traded to the team. Johnson joins the Athletics after being acquired in a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies.
